test.title: Mini-test · Flats and houses to rent

paragraphs.text: One-bedroom flat above a shop, two minutes from the railway station. £750 a month, bills not included. Available now. No pets. Street parking only.
Two bedrooms on the third floor of a building with a lift. £920 a month including heating and water. Shared garden. Available from 1 September. Minimum tenancy twelve months.
One bedroom on the ground floor with a private garden. £800 a month. Pets will be considered. Kitchen fitted this year. Twenty minutes’ walk to the town centre.
A studio flat with river views, suitable for one person. £620 a month. Fully furnished. Gym and bicycle storage in the building. Available for six months only.
A double room in a house shared with three professionals. £550 a month including all bills and internet. A cleaner visits weekly for the shared areas. Non-smokers only.
A three-bedroom house with a driveway for two cars. £1,200 a month. Close to two primary schools. Unfurnished. Available from October.

document.title: Mini-test · Flats and houses to rent

items.quote: £550 a month including all bills and internet

explanation.en: “including all bills and internet” → E. B includes only heating and water.
explanation.kk: «including all bills and internet» → E. B-да бағаға тек жылу мен су кіреді.
explanation.ru: «including all bills and internet» → E. В B в цену входят только отопление и вода.

items.prompt: is available for a short fixed period

explanation.en: “Available for six months only” → D. B, by contrast, has a minimum of twelve months.
explanation.kk: «Available for six months only» → D. B-да, керісінше, ең аз мерзім — он екі ай.
explanation.ru: «Available for six months only» → D. В B, наоборот, минимальный срок — двенадцать месяцев.

items.quote: A three-bedroom house with a driveway for two cars
items.prompt: has space to park more than one car

explanation.en: “a driveway for two cars” → F. A has street parking only.
explanation.kk: «a driveway for two cars» → F. A-да тек көшеде тұраққа болады.
explanation.ru: «a driveway for two cars» → F. В A — только парковка на улице.

items.prompt: may accept tenants who have animals

explanation.en: “Pets will be considered” → C. A says “No pets”.
explanation.kk: «Pets will be considered» → C. A-да тікелей «No pets» делінген.
explanation.ru: «Pets will be considered» → C. В A прямо «No pets».

items.prompt: requires tenants to stay for at least a year

explanation.en: Maple Court states “Minimum tenancy twelve months”. Twelve months is “at least a year” → B.
explanation.kk: Ең аз жалдау мерзімі Maple Court-та көрсетілген: «Minimum tenancy twelve months». Он екі ай — «at least a year» → B.
explanation.ru: Минимальный срок аренды указан у Maple Court: «Minimum tenancy twelve months». Двенадцать месяцев — это «at least a year» → B.

items.quote: two minutes from the railway station

explanation.en: “two minutes from the railway station” → A. The schools in F are not transport.
explanation.kk: «two minutes from the railway station» → A. F-тегі мектептер — көлік емес.
explanation.ru: «two minutes from the railway station» → A. Школы в F — не транспорт.

explanation.en: “Fully furnished” → D. D is used twice — there is an NB. F is “Unfurnished”.
explanation.kk: «Fully furnished» → D. D екінші рет — NB бар. F, керісінше, «Unfurnished».
explanation.ru: «Fully furnished» → D. D второй раз — есть NB. F, наоборот, «Unfurnished».

items.quote: Two bedrooms on the third floor of a building with a lift
items.prompt: is in a building with a lift

explanation.en: A lift is mentioned only for the third-floor flat: “on the third floor of a building with a lift” → B. B is used twice, as the NB allows.
explanation.kk: Лифт тек үшінші қабаттағы пәтерде аталған: «on the third floor of a building with a lift» → B. B әрпі екінші рет — NB бар.
explanation.ru: Лифт упомянут только у квартиры на третьем этаже: «on the third floor of a building with a lift» → B. Буква B второй раз — есть NB.

explanation.en: Only the Castle Lane house is near schools: “Close to two primary schools” → F. F appears twice, which the NB allows.
explanation.kk: Мектеп тек Castle Lane үйінің жанында: «Close to two primary schools» → F. F екінші рет кездеседі, NB бұған рұқсат береді.
explanation.ru: Школы рядом только у дома на Castle Lane: «Close to two primary schools» → F. F встречается второй раз, это допускает NB.

explanation.en: “Kitchen fitted this year” — the flat has recently been improved → C.
explanation.kk: «Kitchen fitted this year» — ас үй биыл орнатылған, яғни пәтер жақында жаңартылған → C.
explanation.ru: «Kitchen fitted this year» — кухню поставили в этом году, то есть квартиру недавно обновили → C.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–10. Look at the six advertisements, A–F. Which advertisement mentions the following? Write the correct letter, A–F. NB You may use any letter more than once.
